## Runs 6–7 — spot checks before the first stacking fan

Raw TSV views precede each derived spectrum below. Region B_1–B_2 is the only connected voltage pair. Run 6 is n_A=+3.2, run 7 n_A=−1.2 (10¹² cm⁻²), D_A≈0 under run-5 calibration; nominal current 10 nA, measured drain used for resistance. Both runs completed, |R|<600 Ω against 5 kΩ full scale, gate currents <0.22 nA, and sample T=1.165–1.292 K.

Run 6 has reproducible spectral content near 7, 14–15, 22–23 and 29–30 T; these are candidates, not four pockets. Run 7 shows ~4–7 T and ~12 T content, but its closest model ABAB pair (5.86, 6.54 T at −1.2) cannot be split by this usable record. Full-record electron onset reports a censored 0.30 T edge; fitting the large 8–10 T MR background contaminates low-field residuals, and the 50 mT sampling below 1 T was explicitly background-only (measure cell 40). Restricting the onset background fit to 0.3–4 T gives `sdh_onset.onset_b=1.0309096914 T` for the 6.7 T tone, uncensored; that track is 1.01 T when fitting to 6 T. The 0.30 T full-record result is not a measured onset. The upper bound choice changes the background, so the ~1.03 T design onset remains extraction-dependent and the fan must check shared-density reproduction.

**Call at this step: B_1–B_2 stacking uninformative.** Electron-side model predictions at n=3.2 are ABAB {7.31,25.78} T versus ABCA 33.09 T. The observed near-harmonic comb does not uniquely match either using one global scale; do not assign the ~29.5 T tone to ABCA or discard a partner solely by integer ratio. Run-5 secondary CNP ridge also permits density-offset regions within this pair (~0.43×10¹² cm⁻²); these are not separately addressable contacts. Next: electron D≈0 fan for frequency trajectories and a changed sampling grid, followed by both ABAB and trilayer overlays, one global scale, harmonic/Luttinger tests and field-window stability. No independent layer-number or LK confirmation has yet been obtained.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
for fid in (6,7):
    r=open_run(f'data/{fid}')
    display(plot_raw(r)); plt.close()
    ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
    R=(r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain)/I
    B=r.col('magnet_field')
    print(f'run {fid}: complete={r.complete}, interrupted={r.interrupted}; R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm; drain={I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
    for col in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr','T_sample'):
        print(col, np.min(r.col(col)), np.max(r.col(col)))
    print('Full record onset diagnostic:'); print(sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    print('Low-field onset diagnostic (exclude large high-field MR from background fit):')
    on=sdh_onset(R,B,b_hi=4,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary())
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
    for hi in (4,6,10):
        sel=(B>=0.3)&(B<=hi); bs=B[sel]; rs=R[sel]
        bg=np.polynomial.Polynomial.fit(bs,rs,5)
        ax[0].plot(bs,rs-bg(bs),label=f'fit to {hi} T',lw=.7)
    ax[0].set(xlim=(.3,4),xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='R minus polynomial in B (Ohm)'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    for lo in (1.,1.5):
        for deg in (3,5):
            f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
            ax[1].plot(f,sp[0]/sp[0].max(),label=f'B>{lo}, degree {deg}')
            p,_=find_peaks(sp[0],prominence=.03*sp[0].max())
            p=sorted(p,key=lambda j:sp[0,j],reverse=True)[:7]
            print('FFT',lo,deg,[(round(float(f[j]),2),round(float(sp[0,j]/sp[0].max()),3)) for j in p])
    ax[1].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT amplitude / maximum'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.suptitle(f'Run {fid}: extraction stability; frequency-bin spacing is not precision')
    fig.tight_layout(); display(fig); plt.close(fig)

## HERA — electron-side Landau fan for frequency trajectories

> **05:25** · D\_A=0 electron fan: n\_A +3.2 to +2.8e12 cm^-2 (11); B 1.03091 to 7.05 T (218 uniform-1/B); base T, Si=0, 10 nA, 3 s dwell, sr1 50 uV · **ETA ~09:10** (≈3h45m)

`investigations/tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4, implemented with `landau-fan-vti`. Gates A/B remain green: operator-run setup and SAFETIES (measure 2–27), grant/VERIFY (31–32 and session_notes), and handoff state/probe (44–46); Gate C runs 0–3 passed. Runs 6–7 are now analyzed in ana 14–15. Choose the electron side because the accessible hole ABAB pair at n=−1.2 has only 0.68 T separation, below its usable spectral resolution. The electron comb requires a density trajectory and grid-change check before any stacking assignment; this fan is not itself a promise of a unique call.

**Operating window and limits.** Region A calibration from run 5: c_tg=0.0027960593093, c_bg=0.0021606964654 F/m², n_offset=−0.08937933224×10¹² cm⁻², D_offset=−0.013 V/nm; ratio data-calibrated, scale geometry-prior. D_A=0, n_A=+3.2→+2.8×10¹² cm⁻²; TG=0.98359→0.86899 V, BG=1.16628→1.01798 V, Si=0. Base T only. B increases from the measured handoff zero to 1.0309096914 T then through the fan to 7.05 T, holding that endpoint for the next decision. No return traverse. All settings lie inside the card's operating limits and normal working envelope.

**Onset, resolution and grid.** Run 6 `sdh_onset(R,B,b_hi=4,r_full_scale=5000).onset_b` = **1.0309096914 T**, uncensored, carried by the ~6.7 T tone. Its track is ~1.01 T with b_hi=6; the default full-record result is censored at 0.30 T and is rejected because the large high-field MR distorts the global background and the sub-1 T acquisition was background-only. This extraction dependence is a hedge; first assess the shared n=3.2 column against run 6. Model `fs_count_b0.abab_fs` at n=2.8 gives {6.0379,22.9142} T; at 3.2 {7.3058,25.7831} T. ABCA F_L spans 28.95–33.09 T. The selected inverse-field span is 0.8281731 T⁻¹, δF=1.20748 T, and the weakest nominal partner has **5.0004 periods**; heavy/singleton separation >2δF. B_max=7.05 T is the rounded-up five-period floor at n=2.8. Scale uncertainty or a later partner onset can reduce the usable periods; no absence claim then.

**218 B rows × 11 n points = 2398 points.** Uniform-1/B spacing 0.00381647 T⁻¹ gives Nyquist 131.01 T: it clears F_L including a 20% scale allowance and the second ridge's ~0.43 density offset, and prevents even the ~131 T content detected in run 6 from folding into the pocket band. Eleven n points (Δn=0.04×10¹² cm⁻²) are the fundamental-ray Nyquist floor including a 20% density-scale margin: ray spacing at B_lo=0.09971×10¹², margin-adjusted half-period=0.04155×10¹². High harmonics are analyzed within each column; this n grid does not support harmonic-ray morphology. This is a narrow high-density test: holes and n<2.8 are excluded because the accessible hole pair merges and the electron partner loses five-period feasibility. The same fine B grid over −1.2…+3.2 at Δn=0.04 would cost about 26 h including margin, while still failing those low-density resolution conditions.

**Acquisition and dynamic range.** Keep run-6 drive 1 V/100 MΩ=10 nA, 13.777 Hz, τ=0.3 s, 24 dB/oct. Use **3 s fast dwell (10τ)** after both gates move, matching the spot check's effective 3 s magnet settle. Fixed sr1 sensitivity 50 µV = 5 kΩ nominal full scale. Run 6 peaks at 530 Ω and run 7 at 587 Ω through 10 T; projecting the electron peak to the low-n corner with conservative (3.2/2.8)² growth gives ~692 Ω. A further 4× MR uncertainty allowance is ~2.77 kΩ, still below 5 kΩ; live stop at 80% full scale. This is an extrapolation, checked as field rises. Keep drain sensitivity 20 mV. Record and plot both temperatures, gate currents, both connected lock-in X/P pairs, and measured B. No autorange or ramp-pacing changes.

**Cost arithmetic.** Total bare field motion 7.05/(1/7.3)=51.465 min, including 7.526 min to the first row. Run 5 at NPLC=1 measured 1.098 s/point with 1 s dwell, and median row interval 5.774 s; runs 6–7 calibrate field overhead at ~3.1 s beyond ΔB×438 s/T. Allow 3.25 s/point for 3 s dwell, paired-gate writes and added reads, plus 6 s/row for magnet settle, 1 s slow delay and flyback. Thus 2398×3.25 + 218×6 + 7.05×438 = 203.2 min; 10% contingency gives 223.5 min, rounded to the stated ETA. Initial gate preparation and freshness reads fit that allowance.

**Checkpoints and stop conditions.** `hera-watch data --next --follow` is armed before execution. Inspect the first three complete rows (~10 min, including positioning), then every 30 min and on completion: leakage, temperature, current continuity, full-scale fraction, flat channels, actual field and measured ETA. Automatic per-point stops: either |I_gate|>1 nA (same session threshold), T off base, nonfinite data, drain outside 8–12 nA, lock-in ≥80% FS, or field mismatch >30 mT; freshness is checked each row. On a guard trip stop, read actual state, notify and drop to E0. **VTI magnet warning:** interrupt stops the sweep but does not stop a supply ramp already commanded; it continues to that row's bounded setpoint. Operator hardware action is needed to stop a ramp itself.

**Analysis commitment.** Raw TSV map first; compare n=3.2 with run 6, then column spectra under several B cutoffs/detrenders. Fit one global scale to the full peak set; overlay ABAB and adjacent-N trilayer models and test harmonic tracking/Luttinger sums. Carry the second CNP-ridge density offset as a spatial confound. An F_L tone with partners requires breakdown/mixing discrimination; LK and independent layer-number checks remain outstanding. Endpoint gates/field hold for that next decision.

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 10.0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)

mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
